description: You are the Practice Manager at Oakwood Medical Group, a multi-specialty outpatient clinic. Incoming patient referrals have been piling up in the shared inbox over the past week and the clinical team cannot process them efficiently without proper organization. Create a 'Referrals' folder in Local Folders with two subfolders: 'Urgent_Referrals' for time-sensitive cases marked [URGENT] (patients who require appointments within 48-72 hours) and 'Routine_Referrals' for standard referrals. Move each referral email to the correct subfolder based on urgency. Add the referring cardiologist Dr. Patricia Nguyen (p.nguyen@bayviewcardiology.com) to the address book — she sends the highest volume of urgent referrals and must be reachable quickly. After moving the urgent referral emails, apply the 'Important' tag (or any available priority tag) to each of the 3 urgent referral emails in the Urgent_Referrals folder so the clinical team can visually distinguish them at a glance. Login: local account, no password needed.
